rows.scope: Tactical bonus action. p = max(0, morale) * 0.042. One Move/Melee/Shoot check per stack per round. Bonus may Move, Melee, Shoot, Defend or Skip. No Wait, no chain, no roll on Defend, Spell, Wait, retaliation, rejection, death or a resolved battle. Challenge results stay off campaign story.

Victory XP uses the completed Hero Hall level, not Town Hall. An unfinished Hall job does not raise the multiplier. Town Hall level 4 with Hall level 3 credits 131, not 144. Hall level 2 with a pending upgrade credits 117.
A living friendly stack at 15 of 40 HP recovers 10 HP from Power 0.2, spends 20 mana, and cannot cast again that round. A dead stack remains an unsupported target.

Each blow adds 0.045 of the dealt damage to that tower, hero or army accumulator. The killing blow adds 5, or 18 for a boss, once. Overkill uses the full blow. Settlement rounds the session total once through rankForXp. A wrecked tower does not lose a rank. That rank loss in the old siege ending is not adopted.
Hero blast spends 40 campaign mana and deals Power*4 + level*6 inside radius 1.6. It grants no experience. The old per-second mana regeneration is not adopted.

Eight distinct creature types can be bought at the existing dwelling, one offer per type. Cancel keeps the open terms. A second offer of a claimed or migrated type is rejected. Same transaction cannot claim twice.
The goal remains 10 cleared waves. This pass did not run an earned Endless journey to that goal.
Hero Hall attribution is corrected. The historical 124-duel route is not a post-change recipe. No earned Wisdom 3 journey was rerun.
No scene trace, rig, Healer body, Charioteer source, package rebuild or paid call in this pass.
